text:
Kathy gets the condominium by survivorship because Bill's deed validly created a tenancy by the entirety, which severed the prior devise to Julie; Tommy takes the pasture land under the will, and Tommy and Julie split the residue, with Kathy's prenuptial agreement barring any elective share. The pretermitted-spouse rule does not apply because Kathy was not omitted—Bill provided for her through the deed—and the prenuptial agreement waives her spousal rights.
CONFIDENCE: 85
